about_the_game:
Take on the role of a young prince or princess from the Star Empire, sent to Earth on a mission of peace. With centuries of mistrust threatening to shatter delicate negotiations, you must forge new bonds, navigate political intrigue, and uncover hidden truths that span light-years. Voices: From the Stars is a story-rich visual novel where every choice you make can tip the balance between war and harmony and reveal the mysteries behind the voices that echo across the cosmos.

Key Features

  • Interstellar Diplomacy & Branching Paths
    Change your future by making critical decisions during peace talks. Your actions influence alliances, shape relationships, and lead to multiple distinct endings.

  • Immersive Storytelling
    Witness the tension and hope of two worlds attempting to reconcile. Experience the personal stakes of a royal figure torn between duty and curiosity.

  • Deep Character Connections
    Build trust with Earth’s inhabitants and your own entourage from the Star Empire. Explore their diverse backgrounds, goals, and secrets as you strive for understanding.

  • Beautiful Artwork
    Hand-drawn backgrounds and expressive character portraits capture both the grandeur of interstellar life and the charm of Earthly locales.

  • Accessible Gameplay
    Simple point-and-click mechanics focus on narrative depth and player choice, making the game approachable for newcomers and engaging for seasoned VN fans.

  • Unlockable CG Gallery
    Collect stunning scenes as you progress, reliving major turning points and revisiting the art that frames each key moment.

  • Steam Achievements & Cloud Saves
    Earn achievements as you uncover hidden paths or succeed in negotiations, and carry your progress between devices with Steam Cloud support.

Will you stand firm in your mission of peace or discover something that changes everything you thought you knew? In Voices: From the Stars, the fate of two worlds rests on your words, your courage, and the secrets you’re willing to uncover.
